summary.text: Amanda Cochrane is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Caledonia-Essex District (2 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 11 Democratic primary.
She was the Democratic nominee for the Vermont State Senate in Caledonia District in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Cochrane won the Democratic primary for the Vermont State Senate Caledonia District on August 13, 2024, defeating Shawn Hallisey.
In the November 5, 2024 general election she received 41.6 percent of the vote and lost to Republican Scott Beck.
